intent: Apply today’s trail closure and signed-group conduct, bind each trail to its endpoint, place the lake north of the village and distinguish relative location from unsupported water-flow inference.
picturePurpose: A code-rendered map moves Lake to the selected cardinal position around Village. The fixed north indicator establishes orientation only; there is no water-flow arrow, terrain, distance or current real-world route claim. Editable route and inference previews preserve the wording and limits of the original dialogue.

workshop.title: 走对路线，放对位置
workshop.instruction: 先改当天路线方案，再接对终点；亲手把湖泊放到地图上，分清已知位置与未知流向。

items.label: 先找今天适用的路线要求
items.prompt: Which route should the group use today?
items.reason: Because给出上方路线今天关闭的原因，everyone should use the stream route直接规定今天走溪边路线。较长路线通观景点，不代表今天能走；这也不是无标识捷径的许可。
items.hint: 先分清路线、终点与今天的限制；地图位置是位置，不能单凭南北方位推断水流。
items.material:

items.label: 把路线与沿途要求一起保留

items.answer: Use the stream route, follow the posted signs and stay with the group.

items.hint: 先分清路线、终点与今天的限制；地图位置是位置，不能单凭南北方位推断水流。

items.label: 亲手放置湖泊，分清位置与流动
items.prompt: Place the lake relative to the village. Does this position establish water flow?
items.answer: The lake is north of the village; this position alone does not establish flow direction.
items.reason: 地图明确给lake north of the village，所以湖泊放在村庄北侧。导游马上否定只凭位置判断水流；图上的N箭头只表示北向，没有提供地形或水道资料。把位置放对，也不能因此画出向南水流。
items.hint: 先分清路线、终点与今天的限制；地图位置是位置，不能单凭南北方位推断水流。
items.material:
Student: The map shows the lake north of the village. Does that mean the water always flows south?
Guide: No. Position alone does not tell us the direction of flow. We need information about the land and the waterways.
Student: So I should not infer movement just from north and south.
